** Minor** · **Data Integrity & Integration** · **Quick win** **Include tool-result tokens in the modality breakdown.** Gemini reports tool-result modalities separately in `toolUsePromptTokensDetails`. ([googleapis.github.io](https://googleapis.github.io/js-genai/release_docs/interfaces/types.UsageMetadata.html?utm_source=openai)) The model discards that field, so `PromptModalityTokenDetails` can report 100 text tokens while `PromptTokens` reports 140. Map and merge the tool-result details into the prompt modality breakdown.
